verdicts.run_gate: PASS — re-extract+resolve completed; ontology/audit tests green

interpretation: One improve-loop iteration (cpt/06-improve.md): diagnose → ONE change → same eval. Diagnosis: starved clean misses were predominantly (a) prompt under-specification — Ontology.system() exposed predicate names only; Unova prose states Swords-of-Justice/forces-of-nature lore with zero appears_in emitted; Blaine+Red cooperation prose emitted opposes not allied_with. governs was (b) object granularity (Gym vs City); involves judge assertions were mostly shape-wrong (character→character vs event→participant). ONE fix: manifest guidance: strings on starved predicates + Ontology.system() renderer (no-op when guidance empty → EDC byte-parity holds). Re-extracted 14 starved-miss docs via ledger-aside (backup at data/_build/recall/pokemon-lore/phase_g_backup; strip-by-source-url; never delete), re-resolved, re-audited same 20 docs seed 0. CLEAN 0.310 (36/116) → 0.360 (59/164). Starved predicates with material movement: governs Δ=+0.25 (0.0→0.25), owns_pokemon Δ=+1.00 (0.0→1.0). Healthy: evolves_into_lore 0.8824→0.7674, located_in 0.7333→0.8824. Healthy non-regression=REGRESSED. Gate 0.6 on clean: FAIL. Next mitigation if continuing: corpus de-scope of cross-region pages (out_of_unit still large) OR a second pass targeting remaining appears_in/allied_with misses with quote-forced extraction — not another prompt tweak in the same class. Graph-side (paired on treated docs): Unova appears_in 0→7, Blaine allied_with 0→3 — the prompt fix moved extractor behavior on the diagnosed class even where clean coverage remains judge-limited. Strict success_criteria.overall=false because evolves_into_lore clean ratio dipped on unpaired judge draws; do not read that dip as proven healthy regression without a fixture replay.
next_mitigation_if_continuing: Corpus de-scope of cross-region pages dominating out_of_unit, OR quote-forced second extract on remaining appears_in/allied_with misses — do not re-tweak guidance in the same class.

graph_side_emission_check.note: direct evidence the fix changed extractor behavior on treated docs
